verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Identity Verification webhooks page that lets developers subscribe to server-side events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) for real-time alerts. That is a registrable outbound event callback rather than a chat-app notification. Link's client-side onEvent callbacks are a different mechanism and are not credited here. missing for 10: documented webhook URL registration mechanics, payload schema, signature verification and delivery/retry semantics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can select which events you want to subscribe to. For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
Subscribe to events and get real-time alerts for changes
